title: Savannah River National Laboratory fire

location.name: Savannah River Site
location.region: Aiken County, South Carolina, United States

public_risk_assessment: No detectable contamination reported in site radiological surveys; independent off-site monitoring completeness not established in this case file.

verified.claim: A fire occurred at the Savannah River National Laboratory.
Site Area Emergency ended at 9:45 p.m. EDT on October 28; protective actions were lifted.
The site reported radiological surveys showed no detectable levels of contamination.
During the incident, site authorities restricted rail, river and air traffic.
One worker was treated for minor injuries, according to a DOE spokesperson quoted by Reuters.

reported_not_confirmed.claim: Local reporting attributed the phrase 'unfiltered ground-level radiological release' to incident information from the site. That does not independently establish an off-site exposure or contamination.
reported_not_confirmed.note: Do not substitute a dispatch report for monitoring measurements.

reported_not_confirmed.claim: Public site releases differ on the declaration time: 5:39 p.m. in release #2 and 5:07 p.m. in release #3. The discrepancy is unresolved in this snapshot.

unknowns: Fire cause and originating material, absent a later documented official determination.
Underlying sampling locations, detection limits and timestamped radiological survey readings.
Whether the initial dispatch phrase was a precautionary classification, measured emission or documentation error.
Whether an independent regulator published a complete event-specific sampling assessment.

timeline.event: Emergency declaration time later stated in site release #3.
Emergency declaration time stated in site release #2.
Site release #2 reports the fire extinguished; restrictions ongoing.
Site Area Emergency terminated and protective actions lifted.

sources.title: Reporting on dispatch wording and emergency response
One injured in fire; no contamination reported

principles: A restriction zone is not a measured contamination zone.
Official statements are attributed, not asserted as independent sensor readings.
Reported wording is not proof of release.
Corroboration requires independent upstream sources, not syndicated repetitions.
This snapshot is not emergency guidance and is not real-time monitoring.
methodology.emergency_guidance: For urgent protective instructions, follow your local emergency management authority.
